segments.en: That's right.

segments.en: It was still a nice surprise.

segments.en: As I was saying, I've got it all planned out.

四百？

segments.en: I thought it would be nice if we had the wedding at your parents' church, and my uncle of course would be officiating.
segments.zh: 我想如果我们在你父母的教堂举行婚礼会很好，我的叔叔当然会主持。

segments.en: We'll meet with him soon for some pre-wedding counselling.
segments.zh: 我们很快就会与他会面，进行一些婚前咨询。

segments.en: The music for the wedding ceremony was a no-brainer.
segments.zh: 婚礼仪式的音乐根本不用费心想。

segments.en: My stepsister and her string quartet will take care of that.
segments.zh: 我的继妹和她的弦乐四重奏会解决这个问题。

segments.en: My cousin will be the official photographer.
segments.zh: 我的表弟将是官方摄影师。

segments.en: I thought it would also be nice if his daughter could sing a solo.
segments.zh: 我想让他女儿唱一首独唱也不错。

segments.en: Did you know that she's going to be a professional opera singer?

segments.en: And then of course the ladies at the church would love to be our caterers for the banquet and will get the youth group to serve us.

segments.en: I was thinking that your friend's band could be our entertainment for the night, though they might have to tone it down a bit.

segments.en: Or we could hire a DJ.

segments.en: What's their name again?

segments.en: I was thinking that we could have an island paradise themed wedding and our theme colour would be a soothing blue-like aquamarine.

segments.en: And there would be a huge seashell on the wall behind the podium where we'll make our toasts.

segments.en: What do you think of small packages of drink mixes for our wedding favours?

segments.en: Who else am I missing?

segments.en: Oh wow.

segments.en: See, it's going to be wonderful.

segments.en: Oh, this wedding is going to be everything I ever dreamed of.

segments.en: When you plan a wedding, the guy needs to propose.

segments.en: Normally it's the man but to propose in this instance means to propose marriage.
segments.zh: 通常是男人，但在这种情况下求婚意味着求婚。

segments.en: So basically this is the part where someone gets down on his knee and he says, you know, sweetie pie, I want to be with you forever.
segments.zh: 所以基本上这是有人跪下的部分，他说，你知道，亲爱的派，我想永远和你在一起。

segments.en: Will you marry me?

segments.en: Right.
segments.zh: 对。

segments.en: To propose.

segments.zh: 所以提出建议就是向某人求婚。

segments.en: That's right.
segments.zh: 没错。

segments.en: But it can also mean something else, right?
segments.zh: 但它也可能意味着别的，对吧？

segments.en: To suggest.
segments.zh: 建议。

segments.en: That's right.
segments.zh: 没错。

segments.en: So I could propose an idea.
segments.zh: 所以我可以提出一个想法。

segments.en: Or I could propose a plan.
segments.zh: 或者我可以提出一个计划。

segments.en: But in this case, to propose has another meaning and it's basically to ask someone to marry you.
segments.zh: 但在这种情况下，提议有另一个含义，基本上是向某人求婚。

segments.en: Okay.
segments.zh: 好的。

segments.en: Very good.
segments.zh: 很好。

segments.en: So now we've proposed to someone.
segments.zh: 所以现在我们已经向某人求婚了。

segments.en: So we need to start planning our wedding and I think one of the first steps is you need to know how many people are going to be there and who you're going to invite.
segments.zh: 所以我们需要开始计划我们的婚礼，我认为第一步是你需要知道有多少人会在那里以及你将邀请谁。

segments.en: That's right.
segments.zh: 没错。

segments.en: So when you're planning a wedding, you have to think about the people that are going to attend the wedding so you prepare a guest list.
segments.zh: 因此，当您计划婚礼时，您必须考虑将要参加婚礼的人，以便您准备客人名单。

segments.en: Okay.
segments.zh: 好的。

segments.en: So a guest list.
segments.zh: 所以一个客人名单。

segments.en: Now it's pretty simple, right?
segments.zh: 现在很简单，对吧？

segments.en: You have a list where you put everyone's name there and you know how many people are coming.
segments.zh: 你有一个列表，你把每个人的名字都放在那里，你知道有多少人来。

segments.en: Exactly.
segments.zh: 正是这样。

segments.en: Okay.
segments.zh: 好的。

segments.en: A guest list.
segments.zh: 客人名单。

segments.en: Now you have your guest list and now you need to pick a place where your wedding will be.
segments.zh: 现在你有了你的客人名单，现在你需要选择一个你的婚礼地点。

segments.en: That's right.
segments.zh: 没错。

segments.en: So we often talk about two parts to a wedding.
segments.zh: 所以我们经常谈论婚礼的两个部分。

segments.en: The first part is the ceremony, the wedding ceremony.
segments.zh: 第一部分是仪式，婚礼。

segments.en: Maybe if you're religious, that happens in a church.
segments.zh: 也许如果你有宗教信仰，那会发生在教堂里。

segments.en: Okay.
segments.zh: 好的。

segments.en: But there's a party afterwards and that's what we're talking about here.
segments.zh: 但是之后有一个派对，这就是我们在这里谈论的。

segments.en: We're talking about a reception.
segments.zh: 我们谈论的是招待会。

segments.en: Okay.
segments.zh: 好的。

segments.en: A reception is basically the party part of the wedding where you drink and eat and listen to music and dance.
segments.zh: 招待会基本上是婚礼的派对部分，您在那里喝酒、吃饭、听音乐和舞蹈。

segments.en: So obviously for that, you need a space, a place to have the party and we call it the reception venue.
segments.zh: 显然，为此，您需要一个空间，一个举办派对的地方，我们称之为接待场所。

segments.en: Okay.
segments.zh: 好的。

segments.en: A venue.
segments.zh: 一个场地。

segments.en: So as you said, the reception is the party and the venue is the place where you have it.
segments.zh: 正如你所说，招待会是派对，场地是你拥有它的地方。

segments.en: Now a venue is not a specific word, right?
segments.zh: 现在一个场地不是一个特定的词，对吧？

segments.en: You can use venue for many different places.
segments.zh: 您可以将 Venue 用于许多不同的地方。

segments.en: That's right.
segments.zh: 没错。

segments.en: So for example, someone's having a concert, I can ask him, hey, what's the venue?
segments.zh: 例如，有人在开演唱会，我可以问他，嘿，场地是什么？

segments.en: Okay.
segments.zh: 好的。

segments.en: That means what is the theater or where's this place you're going to have the concert?
segments.zh: 这意味着什么是剧院，或者你要去哪里举办音乐会的地方？

segments.en: Okay.
segments.zh: 好的。

segments.en: So for example, a stadium can be a venue or a restaurant can be a venue.
segments.zh: 例如，体育场可以是场地，也可以是餐厅可以是场地。

segments.en: Exactly.
segments.zh: 正是这样。

segments.en: So a venue is a place where an event can be held.
segments.zh: 因此，场地是可以举办活动的地方。

segments.en: Okay.
segments.zh: 好的。

segments.en: Very good.
segments.zh: 很好。

segments.en: So now we have our reception venue.
segments.zh: 所以现在我们有了我们的接待场地。

segments.en: We have our guest list and the girl was talking about her uncle officiating.
segments.zh: 我们有我们的客人名单，那个女孩正在谈论她的叔叔主持。

segments.zh: 主持什么意思？

segments.en: Okay.
segments.zh: 好的。

segments.en: So like you said, the verb here is to officiate.
segments.zh: 所以就像你说的，这里的动词是主持。

segments.en: Her uncle will be officiating.
segments.zh: 她的叔叔将主持。

segments.en: That means he will be the person who marries them.
segments.zh: 这意味着他将成为嫁给他们的人。

segments.en: So maybe you've seen movies before where there's a priest who says, you know, do you take this woman to be your lawfully wedded wife until death do you part?
segments.zh: 所以也许你以前看过电影，那里有一位牧师说，你知道，你是否认为这个女人是你合法结婚的妻子，直到死亡你分开？

segments.en: That person who says that, the person who asks the questions, he or she officiates.
segments.zh: 那个说的人，提出问题的人，他或她主持。

segments.en: Okay.
segments.zh: 好的。

segments.en: Officiate.
segments.zh: 主持。

segments.en: So that's basically the action of marrying someone or leading the ceremony.
segments.zh: 所以这基本上是与某人结婚或领导仪式的行为。

segments.en: That's right.
segments.zh: 没错。

segments.en: And in America, this isn't just anybody.
segments.zh: 在美国，这不仅仅是任何人。

segments.en: Someone has to have a license or has to be a priest and has to have the authority to officiate.

segments.zh: 所以这也是一个非常有趣的词，主持人。

segments.en: Now moving on, when we talk about the food for the reception venue, well, we need somebody to cook it and prepare it and that's when we hire caterers.

segments.zh: 没错。

segments.zh: 所以餐饮服务商有点像厨师，但餐饮服务商基本上会为许多人安排一顿饭。

segments.zh: 通常这个人会把食物带给你。

segments.zh: 例如，如果我们要举办派对，Marco，我们要把它扔到 10 英里外的场地，餐饮服务商会把食物带给我们。

segments.en: That's right.
segments.zh: 没错。

segments.en: Or cater a party.
segments.zh: 或迎合聚会。

segments.en: So I've had parties before that I've called caterers to make the food for.
segments.zh: 所以在那之前我有过派对，我打电话给餐饮服务商来做食物。

segments.en: So basically they work with me and I tell them the kind of food I would like and they prepare it.
segments.zh: 所以基本上他们和我一起工作，我告诉他们我想要什么样的食物，他们准备好了。

segments.en: Okay.

segments.zh: 这不是问题。

segments.en: Everything's going to be fine.
segments.zh: 一切都会好起来的。

segments.en: Great.
segments.zh: 太好了。

segments.en: So the next phrase here is also kind of relaxed.
segments.zh: 所以这里的下一个短语也有点放松。

segments.en: It's kind of laid back.
segments.zh: 这有点悠闲。

segments.en: So the woman is still describing some of the things she's prepared for the wedding and she says, hey, listen, don't worry.
segments.zh: 所以这个女人还在描述她为婚礼准备的一些东西，她说，嘿，听着，别担心。

segments.en: The music was a no brainer.
segments.zh: 音乐是轻而易举的。

segments.en: Okay.
segments.zh: 好的。

segments.en: No brainer.
segments.zh: 没有脑残。

segments.en: Okay.
segments.zh: 好的。

segments.en: This is really easy.
segments.zh: 这真的很容易。

segments.en: Well, your brain is inside your head, right?
segments.zh: 好吧，你的大脑在你的脑海里，对吧？

segments.en: So if you say no brainer, it's basically saying you don't have to think about it too much or it's very easy, very simple.
segments.zh: 所以如果你说没有脑子，它基本上是说你不必考虑太多，或者它很容易，非常简单。

segments.en: Okay.
segments.zh: 好的。

segments.en: So I was deciding on where to go on vacation and the options were Thailand or Antarctica.
segments.zh: 所以我决定去哪里度假，选择是泰国或南极洲。

segments.en: That's a no brainer.
segments.zh: 这不费吹灰之力。

segments.en: Thailand.
segments.zh: 泰国。

segments.en: Obviously, I want to go where it's sunny and warm.
segments.zh: 显然，我想去阳光明媚的地方。

segments.en: So a no brainer means I didn't even have to think about it.
segments.zh: 所以不费吹灰之力意味着我什至不必考虑它。

segments.en: It was that easy.
segments.zh: 就这么简单。

segments.en: Right.
segments.zh: 对。

segments.en: The decision making was a no brainer.
segments.zh: 决策是不费吹灰之力的。

segments.en: All right.
segments.zh: 好的。

segments.en: So for our next phrase, the girl was also talking about the music and she was talking about a band, maybe like a rock band and she said, well, maybe they could play, but they would need to tone it down.
segments.zh: 所以对于我们的下一个短语，女孩也在谈论音乐，她在谈论一个乐队，也许就像一个摇滚乐队，她说，好吧，也许他们可以演奏，但他们需要淡化它。

segments.en: Okay.
segments.zh: 好的。

segments.en: So this is a favorite phrase of parents, I think, all over the English speaking world.
segments.zh: 所以这是我认为，在整个英语世界中，这是父母最喜欢的短语。

segments.en: Tone it down.
segments.zh: 调低它。

segments.en: In this case, we're talking about music.
segments.zh: 在这种情况下，我们谈论的是音乐。

segments.en: So maybe like you said, the friend's band is a rock and roll band and it's really loud and angry and in your face, but for a wedding, that's not appropriate.
segments.zh: 所以也许就像你说的，朋友的乐队是一个摇滚乐队，它真的很响亮，很生气，在你的脸上，但对于婚礼来说，这是不合适的。

segments.en: So to tone it down means to make it more appropriate for the occasion.
segments.zh: 所以调低它意味着让它更适合这个场合。

segments.en: So maybe less loud or no offensive language or no swear words.
segments.zh: 所以也许不那么响亮或没有冒犯性的语言或没有脏话。

segments.en: Right.
segments.zh: 对。

segments.en: That's basically what tone it down means, right?
segments.zh: 这基本上就是调低它的意思，对吧？

segments.en: If someone says you need to tone it down, it's a little bit more direct.
segments.zh: 如果有人说你需要调低它，它会更直接一点。

segments.en: Like you said, if your parents tell you this, it's maybe because you're being a little bit too loud or you're yelling or you're being irrespectful.
segments.zh: 就像你说的，如果你的父母告诉你这一点，可能是因为你有点太大声了，或者你在大喊大叫，或者你是无关紧要的。

segments.en: So that's why your parents would tell you, hey, you need to tone it down a bit.
segments.zh: 所以这就是为什么你的父母会告诉你，嘿，你需要把它调低一点。

segments.en: That's right.
segments.zh: 没错。

segments.en: Or sometimes we have this in the office where someone doesn't understand how to communicate in a positive way.
segments.zh: 或者有时我们在办公室里有这个，有些人不明白如何以积极的方式进行沟通。

segments.en: And so they say, oh, that paper you did was really bad.
segments.zh: 所以他们说，哦，你做的那张纸真的很糟糕。

segments.en: It was stupid.
segments.zh: 这是愚蠢的。

segments.en: I don't ever want to see it again.
segments.zh: 我再也不想看到它了。

segments.en: Say, well, maybe you need to tone it down a little bit.
segments.zh: 说，好吧，也许你需要把它调低一点。

segments.en: Think about the words you're using and make them a little bit less harsh.
segments.zh: 想想你正在使用的词语，让它们变得不那么刺耳。

segments.en: So kind of to relax, to reduce your level of being aggressive, being loud, that's to tone it down.
segments.zh: 放松一下，降低你的攻击性，大声，这就是淡化它。

segments.en: Exactly.
segments.zh: 正是这样。

segments.en: Okay.
segments.zh: 好的。

segments.en: A lot of great phrases there.
segments.zh: 那里有很多很棒的短语。

segments.en: Why don't we now go back, listen to our great dialogue one last time and we'll be back to talk a little bit more.
segments.zh: 我们为什么不现在回去，上一次听我们的精彩对话，我们会回来多谈谈。

segments.en: Trina, will you marry me?
segments.zh: 特丽娜，你愿意嫁给我吗？

segments.en: Yes, yes, yes.
segments.zh: 是的，是的，是的。

segments.en: Jared, of course I'll marry you.
segments.zh: 贾里德，我当然会嫁给你。

segments.en: Oh babe, I can't wait to spend the rest of my life with you.
segments.zh: 哦，宝贝，我迫不及待地想和你一起度过余生。

segments.en: I can't wait for all the adventures we're going to have, for all the fights and the laughter.
segments.zh: 我迫不及待地想和你一起经历各种冒险，经历争吵，也分享欢笑。

segments.en: I can't wait to grow old and wrinkly with you.
segments.zh: 我迫不及待地想和你一起慢慢变老，满脸皱纹。

segments.en: Oh Jared, I can't wait for our wedding.
segments.zh: 哦，杰瑞德，我等不及我们的婚礼了。

segments.en: I hope you don't mind, but I've already chosen a date six months from now in the summer.
segments.zh: 我希望你不介意，但我已经在夏天六个月后选择了一个日期。

segments.en: Melissa saw you buying the ring last month, so I had plenty of time to start planning.
segments.zh: 梅丽莎上个月看到你买了这枚戒指，所以我有足够的时间开始计划。

segments.en: She what?
segments.zh: 她什么？

segments.en: Oh don't worry sweetie, I didn't know when you were going to propose.
segments.zh: 哦，别担心，亲爱的，我不知道你什么时候求婚。

segments.en: It was still a nice surprise.
segments.zh: 这仍然是一个不错的惊喜。

segments.en: As I was saying, I've got it all planned out.
segments.zh: 正如我所说，我已经计划好了。

segments.en: There's almost nothing left to do.
segments.zh: 几乎无事可做。

segments.en: I wrote up our guest list and we will have roughly 400 guests attending.
segments.zh: 我写了我们的客人名单，我们将有大约 400 名客人参加。
四百？

segments.en: No need to sweat it.
segments.zh: 不需要出汗。

segments.en: My parents agreed to pay for most of the wedding, which is going to be a low budget anyway.
segments.zh: 我的父母同意支付大部分婚礼的费用，这无论如何都是一个低预算。

segments.en: So roughly 400 people, which means that the hall at Northwood Heights will be our reception venue.
segments.zh: 大约四百人，所以婚宴场地就定在诺斯伍德高地的礼堂。

segments.en: I thought it would be nice if we had the wedding at your parents' church, and my uncle of course would be officiating.
segments.zh: 我想如果我们在你父母的教堂举行婚礼会很好，我的叔叔当然会主持。

segments.en: We'll meet with him soon for some pre-wedding counselling.
segments.zh: 我们很快就会与他会面，进行一些婚前咨询。

segments.en: The music for the wedding ceremony was a no-brainer.
segments.zh: 婚礼仪式的音乐根本不用费心想。

segments.en: My stepsister and her string quartet will take care of that.
segments.zh: 我的继妹和她的弦乐四重奏会解决这个问题。

segments.en: My cousin will be the official photographer.
segments.zh: 我的表弟将是官方摄影师。

segments.en: I thought it would also be nice if his daughter could sing a solo.
segments.zh: 我想让他女儿唱一首独唱也不错。

segments.en: Did you know that she's going to be a professional opera singer?
segments.zh: 你知道她会成为一名职业歌剧歌手吗？

segments.en: And then of course the ladies at the church would love to be our caterers for the banquet and will get the youth group to serve us.
segments.zh: 当然，教堂里的女士们很想成为我们宴会的餐饮服务商，并会让青年团体为我们服务。

segments.en: I was thinking that your friend's band could be our entertainment for the night, though they might have to turn it down a bit.
segments.zh: 我在想你朋友的乐队可以成为我们今晚的娱乐活动，尽管他们可能不得不拒绝它。

segments.en: Or we could hire a DJ.
segments.zh: 或者我们可以聘请 DJ。

segments.en: Your sister's husband could get us a discount with that company that does the decor at weddings.
segments.zh: 你姐姐的丈夫可以让我们在婚礼上做装饰的公司给我们打折。

segments.en: What's their name again?
segments.zh: 他们又叫什么名字？

segments.en: I was thinking that we could have an island paradise themed wedding, and our theme colour would be a soothing blue-like aquamarine.
segments.zh: 我在想我们可以举办一个以岛屿天堂为主题的婚礼，我们的主题颜色将是一种舒缓的蓝色海蓝宝石。

segments.en: And there will be a huge seashell on the wall behind the podium where we'll make our toasts.
segments.zh: 领奖台后面的墙上会有一个巨大的贝壳，我们将在那里做吐司。

segments.en: What do you think of small packages of drink mixes for our wedding favours?
segments.zh: 婚礼回礼用小包装的调饮料粉，你觉得怎么样？

segments.en: Who else am I missing?
segments.zh: 我还想念谁？

segments.en: Oh, your uncle could be our florist, and his wife could make our wedding cake.
segments.zh: 哦，你的叔叔可以是我们的花店，他的妻子可以做我们的婚礼蛋糕。

segments.en: Oh wow.
segments.zh: 哦，哇。

segments.en: See, it's going to be wonderful.
segments.zh: 看，这将是精彩的。

segments.en: Oh, this wedding is going to be everything I ever dreamed of.
segments.zh: 哦，这场婚礼将是我梦寐以求的一切。

segments.en: If I survive the next six months.
segments.zh: 如果我在接下来的六个月里幸存下来。

segments.en: Alright so about weddings and planning out a wedding, do you think 400 guests is a small wedding?
segments.zh: 好吧，关于婚礼和计划婚礼，你认为 400 位客人是一场小型婚礼吗？

segments.en: No.
segments.zh: 不。

segments.en: No, this woman is out of control.
segments.zh: 不，这个女人已经失控了。

segments.en: In fact, in English, we have a word for a bride, or like a woman who's getting married, that describes someone who's completely nuts about the wedding.
segments.zh: 事实上，在英语中，我们对新娘有一个词，或者像一个要结婚的女人，它描述了一个对婚礼完全疯狂的人。

segments.en: We call her a bridezilla.
segments.zh: 我们称她为新娘。

segments.en: Bridezilla.
segments.zh: 新娘。

segments.en: Like Godzilla.
segments.zh: 像哥斯拉一样。

segments.en: Exactly, the movie Godzilla.
segments.zh: 没错，电影哥斯拉。

segments.en: He's a monster.
segments.zh: 他是个怪物。

segments.en: And he's out of control.
segments.zh: 而且他已经失控了。

segments.en: He's out of control.
segments.zh: 他失控了。

segments.en: And a bride who's so obsessed with her wedding that nothing else is important, she is a bridezilla.
segments.zh: 一个对她的婚礼如此着迷以至于没有其他事情很重要的新娘，她是一个新娘。

segments.en: Now it's a very big thing for a woman, right, for her wedding to be nice and perfect and everything.
segments.zh: 现在，对一个女人来说，这是一件非常大的事情，对，她的婚礼是美好而完美的，一切都是如此。

segments.en: Do you think guys are more relaxed in this sense?
segments.zh: 你认为男人在这个意义上更放松吗？

segments.en: I don't know.
segments.zh: 我不知道。

segments.en: I think it depends on the guy, as always.
segments.zh: 我认为这取决于那个人，一如既往。

segments.en: There are some people who want to be very involved, and some people who don't care.
segments.zh: 有些人想要非常投入，有些人不在乎。

segments.en: But in general, I think men are less worried about the details.
segments.zh: 但总的来说，我认为男人对细节的担忧并不那么担心。

segments.en: Just as long as there's a wedding, it's fine.
segments.zh: 只要有婚礼就好了。

segments.en: Exactly.
segments.zh: 正是这样。

segments.en: Although a lot of men, when the wedding actually happens, start to get very nervous.
segments.zh: 虽然很多男人，当婚礼真正发生时，开始变得非常紧张。

segments.en: But kind of like having doubts, maybe cold feet.
segments.zh: 但有点像有怀疑，也许是冷脚。

segments.en: Yes, cold feet.
segments.zh: 是的，冷脚。

segments.en: Like should I get married?
segments.zh: 比如我应该结婚吗？

segments.en: Should I not get married?
segments.zh: 我不应该结婚吗？

segments.en: I think it's very interesting because you see this in movies a lot.
segments.zh: 我认为这很有趣，因为你经常在电影中看到这一点。

segments.en: And I've always wondered how often or how common is it for a guy or a girl to say no or to leave a wedding when it has already started.
segments.zh: 我一直想知道一个男人或一个女孩在婚礼已经开始时说不或离开婚礼的频率或频率如何。

segments.en: Because you know, you have invited all these people, all these friends and family, maybe people came from different countries, and food is paid for, venue.
segments.zh: 因为你知道，你邀请了所有这些人，所有这些朋友和家人，也许人们来自不同的国家，食物是付费的，场地。

segments.en: You spend so much money on a wedding and for you to say no.
segments.zh: 你在婚礼上花了这么多钱，让你拒绝。

segments.en: I don't know how common it is.
segments.zh: 我不知道它有多普遍。

segments.en: It's very common in movies, but I really don't know anyone who's experienced this.
segments.zh: 这在电影中很常见，但我真的不知道有谁经历过这种情况。

segments.en: I don't either, actually, now that you bring it up.
segments.zh: 其实我也没有，现在你提出来了。

segments.en: So maybe we could talk about this.
segments.zh: 所以也许我们可以谈论这个。

segments.en: Is this common in your country?
segments.zh: 这在你们国家很常见吗？

segments.en: First of all, do people spend a lot of money on weddings?
segments.zh: 首先，人们会在婚礼上花很多钱吗？

segments.en: And second of all, have you ever heard of someone actually leaving the wedding before they finished?
segments.zh: 其次，你有没有听说过有人在结束之前就离开了婚礼？

segments.en: Yes, during the ceremony.
segments.zh: 是的，在仪式上。

segments.en: Not before, during.
segments.zh: 不是之前，期间。

segments.en: During the ceremony.
segments.zh: 在仪式期间。

segments.en: So our website is EnglishPod.com.
segments.zh: 所以我们的网站是 Englishpod.com。

segments.en: And we hope to see you there.
segments.zh: 我们希望在那里见到你。

segments.en: Until next time.
segments.zh: 下次再见。

segments.en: Bye.
segments.zh: 再见。
